last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 final fresh non-prescription knee osteoarthritis self-management topics. The main query set returned 180 unique PubMed PMIDs, 179 fetched article records, and 179 abstracts available for inspection. Retained numeric effects or valid relative effects were verified for PMIDs: 30967128, 37684597, 36511925, 40198073, 30543021, 33524515, 31662383, 35637515, and 38639940. Nine retained references were added across 9 new entries. New entries cover walking, aerobic exercise, diet, yoga, massage, knee brace, low-level laser, mindfulness, and self-administered acupressure. Resistance exercise, aquatic exercise, tai chi, glucosamine, chondroitin, curcumin, boswellia, collagen, omega-3 krill oil, ginger, acupuncture, heat therapy, TENS, self-management, and home exercise topics were linked to existing entries. Pilates, vitamin D, taping, foam rolling, and CBT topics were screened out because the retrieved PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control result or valid relative effect.
